item.title: Drake’s ‘ICEMAN’ Scores Third Week Atop Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the Billboard Breakdown, your weekly update on the latest music trends. I'm your host, and today we're diving into the top albums on the Billboard 200 chart. Let's see who's leading the pack."
[Music transitions]
Host: "For the third week in a row, Drake's 'ICEMAN' is holding strong at number one, earning 171,000 equivalent album units in the US. That's a 24% drop from last week, but it's still a impressive feat. 'ICEMAN' is now one of five Drake albums to spend at least three weeks at the top spot."
[Music clip from "ICEMAN" plays]
Host: "But Drake's not the only one making waves on the chart. Paul McCartney is debuting at number five with his new album 'The Boys of Dungeon Lane', marking his 22nd top 10 album. And aespa is capturing their third top 10 spot with 'LEMONADE' at number nine."
[Music clip from "The Boys of Dungeon Lane" plays]
Host: "The rest of the top 10 is filled with familiar faces, including Ella Langley, Morgan Wallen, and Noah Kahan. And Michael Jackson's classic album 'Thriller' is still hanging in there at number six."
[Music clip from "Thriller" plays]
Host: "That's all for today's Billboard Breakdown. To see the full chart, head to Billboard's website on June 9. And for all the latest music news, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode of the Billboard Breakdown!"
